response.description: Announcing the public preview of Application Gateway WAF Insights. Azure Application Gateway WAF now offers WAF Insights, providing an interactive view of logs and metrics. WAF Insights enables quick investigation of blocked requests, analysis of attack patterns, and easy access to details like rule IDs and client IPs. Enhanced filters and visualizations make troubleshooting more efficient and help identify false positives, streamlining WAF tuning. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: WAF Insights for Application Gateway
